items.title: শেয়ারবাজারে ঋণ করে বিনিয়োগ করলে লাভ কতটা, ঝুঁকি কেমন

items.title: India faces prolonged food inflation
items.description: Indian farmer Amarsingh Gushinge wants to sow wheat and chickpeas in coming weeks to capitalise on attractive prices, but dwindling water supplies after below-average monsoon rains are preventing him from planting either crop.
